job.title: Maintenance Electrician
job.description:
Job description
Maintenance Electrician
Full-Time | Day Shift | South Eastern Suburbs, Melbourne
$100,000 (negotiable) + Super + On-Call Allowance
Inter Industrial Services is currently seeking an experienced Maintenance Electrician to work with a well-established packaging client located in Melbourne’s south eastern suburbs.
This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified electrician looking for a secure, full-time position within an established manufacturing and packaging environment.
The Role
Working as part of the maintenance team, you will be responsible for ensuring production equipment, machinery and site electrical systems operate safely, reliably and efficiently.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Preventative and reactive electrical maintenance
  • Fault finding and breakdown repairs on production machinery
  • Electrical troubleshooting and diagnostics
  • Installation, testing and commissioning of electrical equipment
  • Maintaining and repairing automated production equipment
  • Supporting continuous improvement and reliability initiatives
  • Completing scheduled preventative maintenance
  • Ensuring all work is completed in accordance with safety and compliance requirements
  • Working closely with production and maintenance teams to minimise downtime
  • Participating in an on-call roster as required
About You
We are looking for a motivated and hands-on electrician who has experience working in a manufacturing, production or packaging environment.
You will ideally have:
  • Australian Electrical Licence – must have.
  • Previous industrial maintenance experience
  • Strong electrical fault-finding and troubleshooting skills
  • Experience with automated production machinery
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings
  • A strong understanding of workplace health and safety
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • A proactive approach to preventative maintenance and equipment reliability
What's On Offer?
  • $100,000 ++ (negotiable) per annum + super
  • On-call allowance
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Day shift
  • Stable employment with an established packaging business
  • Modern manufacturing environment
  • Opportunity to work with a highly experienced maintenance team
  • Career development and long-term employment opportunities
Apply Now
If you are an experienced Maintenance Electrician looking for your next long-term opportunity within the manufacturing and packaging industry, we would love to hear from you.
Apply now through Inter Industrial Services and take the next step in your career.
Inter Industrial Services – When you want it done right.

job.title: Experienced Food Production / Machine operators - Day / Arvo Position available
job.description:
INTER INDUSTRIAL SERVICES are currently seeking reliable and motivated Casual Production Operators to join our manufacturing team.
We have multiple positions available across food production, blending, chemical blending, forklift operations and Vertical Form-Fill-Seal (VFFS) packaging across Day and Afternoon Shifts in the South Eastern Suburbs.
These roles are suited to people who enjoy hands-on work, can follow production procedures and are committed to maintaining high standards of safety, quality and housekeeping.

Key Responsibilities
Depending on your experience and assigned role, your duties may include:
  • Operating industrial food blenders and mixing equipment.
  • Performing chemical blending and batching in accordance with recipes, specifications and safety procedures.
  • Accurately weighing, measuring and adding raw materials and ingredients.
  • Operating Vertical Form-Fill-Seal (VFFS) packaging machines.
  • Setting up, monitoring and making basic adjustments to production and packaging equipment.
  • Operating forklifts to move raw materials, packaging and finished products.
  • Loading and unloading materials safely.
  • Completing production records, batch documentation and quality checks.
  • Monitoring product quality and reporting any issues or discrepancies.
  • Cleaning and maintaining production equipment and work areas.
  • Following all food safety, chemical handling, WHS and site procedures.
  • Working safely and efficiently to meet daily production requirements.
About You
We are looking for people who have:
  • Previous experience in manufacturing, production, food processing or chemical blending.
  • Experience operating blending or mixing equipment.
  • Experience operating VFFS packaging machinery is highly regarded.
  • A current Forklift Licence (LF) and practical forklift experience is highly desirable.
  • Good understanding of workplace health and safety procedures.
  • Experience handling chemicals safely is highly regarded.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately follow recipes, formulas and production instructions.
  • Good mechanical aptitude and basic troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, hands-on production environment.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Reliable attendance, a strong work ethic and a safety-first attitude.
  • Ability to undertake manual handling and physical production duties.
What We Offer
  • Multiple casual positions available.
  • Competitive casual hourly rates.
  • Opportunities for ongoing work for the right candidates.
  • Training and support provided where required.
  • Variety of production and manufacturing duties.
  • A safe and supportive team environment.

If you have relevant production, blending, forklift or packaging experience and are looking for ongoing casual work, we would like to hear from you.
Apply now with your resume outlining your relevant experience.
Please note only successful candidates will be contacted and interviews will be held in Knoxfield.
